name: purple
shortdesc: purple-mri: adult ex vivo segmentation, surfaces and parcellation
longdesc: Process one adult ex vivo hemisphere with purple-mri Docker 1.2.0. Assign the main MRI to exactly ONE tag matching its contrast (T2w, CISS, FLASH or T2star) and hemisphere (LH or RH). Download six attachments containing segmentations, seven final atlas merges, surface parcellations, surfaces, statistics and reports. Extract them together and overlay the segmentations on your original MRI.
author: Pulkit Khandelwal
